tools.name: defi_top_yields
tools.description: Top DeFi pools by APY with 30d mean, volatility, IL risk and forecast; filter by chain, project, stablecoin, TVL. Signed and timestamped. $0.02 per call.

tools.name: defi_yield_movers
tools.description: Pools with the largest APY change over 1d or 7d, up and down. Anomaly feed. $0.02 per call.

tools.name: stablecoin_peg_monitor
tools.description: Every depegged USD stablecoin plus the largest by supply, with price deviation and 1d/7d supply change. $0.02 per call.

tools.name: token_security_check
tools.description: Honeypot, taxes, mintable, proxy, owner powers and holder concentration with a 0-100 risk score. $0.02 per call.

tools.name: yieldprobe_info
tools.description: Free. Prices, payment network, HTTP endpoints and how to pay. Call this first if unsure.
